subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing emission point is clear, but schema, span parenting, redaction, and low-cardinality reason taxonomy are public observability contract choices.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and export it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate spawn span only
options.body: Attach terminal information to the `sessions_spawn` tool span where possible, accepting weaker coverage for deaths after the spawn tool returns.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle redesign
options.body: Leave this issue open under broader subagent lifecycle work, accepting that downstream death clustering remains blind until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and export it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the subagent terminal paths is repeated work by steipete on registry lifecycle and cleanup behavior.
